mission.description: The drone leaves its base at (5976, -11120) and has to end up at (-15837, 17229). On the way it must stop at A (Alsip Fire Department Heliport) at (-4175, -25029), B (Chicago Helicopter Experience Heliport) at (4271, -5759), C (John H. Stroger Hospital of Cook County Heliport) at (2201, -2802), D (Mc Donald's Plaza Heliport) at (-20227, -5771); visit A before B; visit B before C; visit C before D. Keep it no lower than 40 m and no higher than 80 m. The restricted areas and obstacles (Z1 [Chicago Midway International Airport (KMDW, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z2 [Chicago O'Hare International Airport (KORD, large_airport) protection radius 8000 m], Z3 [Chicago Executive Airport (KPWK, medium_airport) protection radius 5000 m]) are off limits, and that includes cutting across a corner of one on the way between two stops. The whole trip may not be longer than 102772 meters. The battery only allows 107923 energy units, where energy = route length + 30 x total climb (so low altitudes save battery). (START is First Area Police Hdqtrs Heliport; DEST is Presence Holy Family Medical Center Heliport.) Coordinates are meters east/north of the region center.
